title: Sign of charge B
description: Essential: Student must state that sphere B's charge is positive (+q) or like-charged to A.

title: Force equilibrium equation
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the final equilibrium condition: kq²/d² = mg tanθ.

title: Free-body diagram reasoning
description: Important: Student must correctly resolve gravity into components along and perpendicular to the incline, identifying that Coulomb force balances the down-slope component.

title: Coulomb's law application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply Coulomb's law (F = kq²/d²) for the force between the two point charges.

title: Tension condition usage
description: Important: Student must use the given condition (tension = 0) to justify that the Coulomb force is the only horizontal force balancing the down-slope gravitational component.

title: Final ratio q/d
description: Essential: Student must correctly solve the equilibrium equation to obtain q/d = sqrt(mg tanθ / k).

title: Incorrect force resolution
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly resolves gravity (e.g., uses mg sinθ or mg cosθ without the correct trigonometric factor for the horizontal component on the incline).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student assumes sphere B has a negative charge, leading to an attractive force inconsistent with the equilibrium and tension condition.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student verifies dimensional consistency of the final expression for q/d.
